output:
I found four households: **HH-0586, HH-0592, HH-0928 and HH-4821**. In each, a signed householding agreement puts three accounts into one billing group, but the portfolio system still bills them in two groups.

The four cases follow the same pattern. The householding letter covers the joint account, a spouse's traditional IRA and an adult child's individual account. It says they "are billed together as one group from the next billing cycle." In `portfolio/household.json`, though, the joint account and the IRA are in one billing group and the child's account is in a second. Both groups were last changed on the date of the child's advisory agreement, which is before the householding letter was signed. So the billing groups were never updated after the letter.

| Household | Agreement (signed) | Billing groups | Groups last changed |
|---|---|---|---|
| HH-0586 Quarshie | AGR-0586-3 (2024-06-07) | BG-0586-1 (joint + Saoirse's IRA), BG-0586-2 (Amara) | 2021-09-01 |
| HH-0592 Haddad | AGR-0592-3 (2023-10-20) | BG-0592-1 (joint + Bilal's IRA), BG-0592-2 (Fatima) | 2021-09-01 |
| HH-0928 Jablonski | AGR-0928-3 (2024-03-05) | BG-0928-1 (joint + Hugo's IRA), BG-0928-2 (Nikhil) | 2021-09-01 |
| HH-4821 Okafor-Lind | AGR-4821-3 (2024-11-18) | BG-4821-1 (joint + Henrik's IRA), BG-4821-2 (Ngozi) | 2021-09-14 |

Things I checked that don't change the answer:
- **No other householding agreements:** across all 92 CRM files, these are the only four.
- **Nothing undoes them:** no note or activity revokes or overrides the letters. The latest annual reviews (2025-10-14) say "No changes requested."
- **Accounts still open:** the custodian lists all twelve accounts as open on 15 April 2026.
- **Same fee schedule:** both groups in each household use the tiered FS-STD schedule, which applies per billing group. Splitting the accounts therefore stops the household's combined assets from reaching the lower-rate tiers. I didn't calculate how much each household may have been overbilled.
- **Excluded on purpose:** some households have advisory agreements that say "billed together" or "billed with the taxable account" (e.g. HH-3058, HH-9571, HH-0607). These are not householding agreements, so I left them out. HH-7350's agreement says Aiko "has not agreed to household billing," which supports billing her account separately.

Work only from these files. End your answer with one fenced json block with these fields:

- "unresolved": the households the files cannot settle, each as {"household_id": ..., "explanation": one sentence}, or [] if none
